name: universal-lint
description: Silently runs each language's standard linter (read-only — never autofixes) on just-written Shell, Java, Kotlin, JS/TS, Python and Go files after Write/Edit, surfacing any findings as additional context for Claude to fix (shellcheck, checkstyle, ktlint, eslint, ruff check, golangci-lint/go vet); no-op when the linter is absent.
